summary: Validated refresh split-button backend/frontend behavior for Product Detail with mocked refresh flow only. Confirmed method body compatibility, method forwarding contract, dropdown rendering (Auto/Manual/separator/providers), and no refresh request when opening/toggling the menu.

critical.issue: Observed 500 DuplicateKeyError on product_code during parallel product creation (initial run with pytest xdist workers).

action_items: Harden product_code generation/insert path to avoid DuplicateKeyError under concurrent /api/products requests.
Keep refresh behavior as MOCKED in tests: do not invoke real eBay/provider refresh during this validation scope.
Optional cleanup: address existing ProductDetail React Hook dependency warnings (build remains healthy).
critical_code_review_comments: Refresh endpoint keeps backward compatibility via optional body (`body: Optional[RefreshAllRequest] = None` then fallback to default).
Refresh method forwarding is correctly wired to `fetch_html(..., method=body.method or 'auto', providers=...)`.
ProductDetail split button uses unique data-testid values for control/toggle/menu/methods/provider entries.

success_rate.backend: 100% (8/8 focused refresh tests passing after test hardening)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Browser smoke used QA admin login, opened an eBay-linked product, opened/toggled refresh dropdown only, verified Auto/Manual + provider list + separator, and confirmed zero POST /api/products/{id}/refresh calls unless a method option is clicked.
rca of the issue: Reproduction for concurrency issue: run product-creating tests with xdist workers (parallel POST /api/products using similar title-derived code paths). One request returned 500 with Mongo DuplicateKeyError on unique index `product_code_1`. Mitigation: enforce retry-on-duplicate or atomic unique code generation for create_product; meanwhile tests were stabilized with less collision-prone titles and serial execution for this focused suite.
